column1: # CAP glyphs: a hash of a glyph cell's 4-bit pixels (tools/peassets/cap_text.py, glyph_hash) and its character.
# Added as rooms are worked through; seeded from the Akropolis square (rooms/akropolis/square/bundle).
# A line naming several characters is a picture they share (l and I are drawn alike). Which one a payload's
# cell is comes from the bundle's `glyphs` overrides in asset_data.py; without one the decoder guesses and warns.
